title: Overadvance Fee Charges on Operating Lines of Credit
content:
An Operating Lines of Credit product that permits overadvances charges an overadvance fee on an advance that took the line past its available credit.

## Rule

On a product with an overadvance tolerance above zero, an overadvance fee is charged once against an advance that took outstanding principal past the line's available credit, as a separate fee charge with the overadvance fee code pointing to that advance, on the day the overadvance shows on the records: the day of the advance itself, or, when the borrowing base that reveals it is recorded later, the day that borrowing base is recorded.

The overadvance fee on the line's latest advance is fixed only after the association has recorded its own borrowing base on the line's most recent certificate.

## Business effect

The fee appears in the line's transaction history as a fee charge with the overadvance fee code, pointing to the advance it arises from, and the fees the line shows as owed rise by the same amount. One advance carries one overadvance fee.

## Platform reference: `assess_overadvance_fee_10e059b9`

**Capability.** Assesses an overadvance fee on an operating line against the advance it arises from. One call books one new fee charge with the fee code for overadvances, dated today and marked as a platform booking, pointing to the named advance, and raises the line's fees owed by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `assess_overadvance_fee_10e059b9` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `line_id` | Loan number of the operating line the fee is charged on, as shown when the member's operating lines are looked up | Identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | Reference number of the advance the fee arises from, as shown in the line's transaction history | Identifier |
| `amount` | The fee to charge | USD, always positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to cents before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt rendered as text with `txn_id` (reference number of the new fee charge), `line_id` (the line charged), `fee_code` (the literal "overadvance"), `amount` (the USD fee, 2 decimal places), `effective_date` (today's date, in year-month-day form), `fees_due` (the line's fees owed after the charge, USD, 2 decimal places) and `status`, the literal "assessed", meaning the charge is on the line.

## Contract questions

**What date does the charge carry?** The call dates the charge today, the day it is booked.

**What does the member see afterwards?** The new charge in the line's transaction history and in the fees the line shows as owed.
